Job Description : 

 
 
 
 • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or in “STEM” Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math) from an accredited college or university. 
 • 5+ years of experience in software industry with at least 3 years in software technical support experience preferred. 
 • Strong knowledge of C++ programming language and of databases/ SQL. 
 Expected Skillset: 
 • Hands on programming experience and knowledge of C++, Java, and Oracle 
 • Ability to work on multiple problems simultaneously 
 • Strong problem solving and analytical skills demonstrated by the ability to assimilate new information, understand complex topics 
 • Strong familiarity with Linux OS and performance optimizations. Knowledge of Linux internals and administration is highly desired 
 • Robust understanding of database technologies and performance optimization 
 • Excellent written and verbal communication 
 • Experience with Scrum/ Agile development, 
 • Self-starter who is motivated to learn and is at ease working as part of a team of highly talented professionals 
 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
